_comment: Checks for ~/.claude/workflows/director.js, modelled on the geolarp and RescueDogs director.json files; run each from a worktree root.
All three checks were proven green (exit 0) on origin/main 16818be (2026-10-08), one at a time: CHECK_IMAGE 109s, CHECK_SUITE 95s, CHECK_BUILD 50s.
Where Docker's credential helper can't run (WSL interop off), prefix each with `export DOCKER_CONFIG=<dir with {"auths":{}}>;`.

The empty env file exists because compose requires env_file; the real one is never copied into a worktree, and -p spoketowork-wf keeps one image for all worktrees without touching the dev stack's volumes.

The read-only mount of the git common dir is there because a worktree's .git points into the main repo's git dir; `--ignore-scripts` skips `prepare`, which would otherwise write core.hooksPath into the shared config.
GIT_AUTHOR_* are set because compose sets GIT_COMMITTER_NAME from GIT_AUTHOR_NAME, which is empty when unset and breaks tests that make temporary commits.
The throwaway /app/node_modules and /app/.next volumes are seeded from the image per run, so parallel worktrees never share state.
CHECK_SUITE mirrors ci.yml: detect-project, lint, type-check, validate:breakpoints and `pnpm exec vitest run` (388 files, 4047 tests passed, 14 skipped).

CI feeds real Supabase and test-user secrets to vitest; without them four suites fail on missing env (useConversationRealtime, key-service, message-service, admin-user contract), so CHECK_SUITE passes inert placeholder values such as http://localhost:54321 and example.test addresses, which are not credentials.
CHECK_BUILD uses NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL=https://spoketowork.com to match public/CNAME, builds with no Supabase variables, and fails if the build leaves tracked changes.

These checks do NOT cover the security audit, the SQL-injection grep, gitleaks, Storybook (`build-storybook`), coverage thresholds, Playwright E2E, Pa11y accessibility, the component-structure, monitor or keep-alive workflows, deploy.yml, or anything needing a real Supabase project; tests that pass here against placeholders may behave differently with real credentials.

checks.CHECK_SUITE: [ -f .env ] || : > .env; G=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=director-check GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=director-check@localhost docker compose -p spoketowork-wf run --rm --no-deps -T -v /app/node_modules -v /app/.next -v "$G":"$G":ro -e NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL=https://spoketowork.com -e NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://localhost:54321 -e NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=placeholder-anon-key -e TEST_USER_PRIMARY_EMAIL=primary@example.test -e TEST_USER_PRIMARY_PASSWORD=placeholder-pw -e TEST_USER_SECONDARY_EMAIL=secondary@example.test -e TEST_USER_SECONDARY_PASSWORD=placeholder-pw -e TEST_USER_TERTIARY_EMAIL=tertiary@example.test -e TEST_USER_TERTIARY_PASSWORD=placeholder-pw --entrypoint sh spoketowork -c 'set -e; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline; node scripts/detect-project.js >/dev/null; pnpm lint; pnpm type-check; pnpm validate:breakpoints; pnpm exec vitest run; echo SUITE_OK'
checks.CHECK_BUILD: [ -f .env ] || : > .env; G=$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir); GIT_AUTHOR_NAME=director-check GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL=director-check@localhost docker compose -p spoketowork-wf run --rm --no-deps -T -v /app/node_modules -v /app/.next -v "$G":"$G":ro -e NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_URL=https://spoketowork.com --entrypoint sh spoketowork -c 'set -e; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --prefer-offline; node scripts/detect-project.js >/dev/null; pnpm build; echo BUILD_OK' && git diff --exit-code --stat
